scripts.build: mkdir -p dist; buble --no modules src/style-mod.js | sed -e 's/export var StyleModule/var StyleModule = exports.StyleModule/' > dist/style-mod.cjs
scripts.build:win: if not exist dist mkdir dist; buble --no modules src/style-mod.js | Out-String -Stream | %{ $_ -replace 'export var StyleModule', 'var StyleModule = exports.StyleModule' } > dist/style-mod.cjs
scripts.build-readme: builddocs --name style-mod --main src/README.md --format markdown src/*.js > README.md
